value.rationale: A complete, naturally motivated infinite-parameter classification for a documented pentagonal numerical-semigroup family. It reveals rare structural exceptions including a nonobvious three-generator index 40, and a contrast with telescopic triangular triples. Frobenius sequence table alone cannot decide the symmetry predicate. The theorem is not an arbitrary finite slice or a mere renaming of an existing result.
